rawContent: “As a Black activist and member of #BlackLivesMatter, I am concerned that the FBI is deploying high-tech tools to profile, police, and punish Black people who stand up for racial justice.” - @culturejedi, on why we're suing the FBI: https://t.co/0Uk7p4ONq5 #ProtectBlackDissent

@Participant @ava In 2014, our country reeled from the murder of Michael Brown at the hands of a Missouri police officer. In response, Black youth activists broadcast their resistance live on Twitter for the world to see. #BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/cH6aEPDmUv
